thread:
Alex: FYI — incoming from ACME. They say ~1.1M credits gone overnight after their nightly embed/rerank job. Can someone triage?
Maria: Ack. Do we have a quick usage dump for acct id 54321? @Sanjay can you pull the usage window 01:30-03:30 UTC?
Sanjay: Pulling. Looks like a big spike starting at 02:00 UTC coinciding with their scheduled job. I see many 503/502s and immediate client retries in logs. They batch ~512 inputs per request.
Sanjay: pasted log excerpt:
```
[02:00:58] POST /v1/embeddings 503 for job batch_id=abc123
[02:01:00] client retry (no idempotency key) -> POST /v1/embeddings 200 tokens=512 cost=1200
[02:01:02] POST /v1/embeddings 503
[02:01:03] client retry -> POST /v1/embeddings 200 tokens=512 cost=1200
```
Maria: If the client retried whole batch each time without idempotency that explains multiply-charged tokens. Customer's job had ~9000 docs and they retried ~8x in some windows.
Ops-Bot: ingest-service scaled from 2 -> 8 pods due to concurrency surge at 02:01 UTC (autoscaler event).
Support-Engineer: Customer says they also expected a promo/trial credit to apply. Billing looked like it didn't kick in for these bulk endpoints. Can Billing confirm promo scope?
Billing-Bot: Promo 'ACME-TRIAL-2025' details: scopes=["hosted_api_chat","hosted_api_generation"], excluded_endpoints=["/v1/embeddings","/v1/re_rank"], expiry=2025-06-30. Promo not applied to embedding calls.
Dave: Oof. Two problems colliding: excluded promo + retry storm. Quick math: 9k docs * avg tokens 800 * cost-per-token => ~1.1M credits after retries.
Maria: Proposed customer-facing remediation: 1) issue provisional credit (~1.2M) while we investigate 2) explain excluded endpoints + recommend SDK idempotency and smaller batches 3) long-term: consider changing promo rules or adding guardrails.
Alex: Support, can you prepare the credit and patch messaging? Also need internal tickets for an SDK change to encourage Idempotency-Key and server-side idempotency for embeddings.
Support-Engineer: Opening support ticket now. Initial recommended credit: 1.2M to be safe. Asking ACME for their job config and client library version.
Support-Engineer: Created ticket #7890 for acct 54321, assigned to me. Will CONFIRM before applying credits.
Support-Bot: Support ticket #7890 created (acct=54321) assigned_to=@Support-Engineer.
Sanjay: For eng-ml/eng-runtime: repro steps to simulate — run a bursty batch job, inject intermittent 503, observe client-side retries sending the whole payload repeatedly. Example quick repro script:
```
for i in {1..20}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings \n    -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n    -d '{"input":["<large-doc>"], "model":"embed-large" }'
  sleep 0.2
done
```
Sanjay: Key points to test: missing Idempotency-Key, client lib default retry count, and batch size effects on cost accounting.
Maria: Ops/Platform: can we add a protection rule — if a single account >10x baseline for 1h, pause/notify and require manual review? Also add metric for embeddings.retry.rate.
Ops-Bot: Created alert template 'embeddings.retry.rate >5% for 5m' and flagged for review by eng-sre.
Billing-Bot: Audit note: we should consider allowing promos to opt-in for bulk ingest on a per-case basis (security/abuse checks).
Dave: Action items summary: 1) support: provisional credit 1.2M + customer comms 2) eng-sdk: default to surface guidance and Idempotency-Key helper 3) eng-runtime: consider server-side idempotency or de-dupe for batch endpoints 4) product: revisit promo scoping docs 5) ops: throttle rule + alerting.
Alex: Thanks everyone. I'll draft a short post for the customer and drop in ticket #7890. Follow-ups in #support and #eng-runtime. :thumbsup:
Billing-Bot: provisional_credit_suggested=1200000
Support-Bot: follow-up reminder set for 48h on ticket #7890
